question: Where are worshippers fully established when Śiva is understood in his complete nature?
premises: Śiva is called supreme in this full nature.
This fullness includes the powers just described.
Worshippers are established directly in that reality.
inference: True worship culminates in direct establishment in the supreme Śiva whose nature is fully expressed through his powers.
plain_english: This one, of such full nature, is called the supreme Śiva; therefore worshippers are directly and fully established right there.
